{{Quote|Activate the bridge and get them across immediately.''"<br />"''Initiating plasma projectors.|[[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] and a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
A '''plasma bridge''' was a technological device with the function of controlling access to an area. It consisted of a projected span of energy that was able to support the weight of people, ground vehicles and landspeeders. It could be quickly deactivated to sever the access to the area, removing the grounding from anyone caught in the middle of it.
